verses.en: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
verses.sm: LE au uso e, ou te faailoa atu ia te outou le tala lelei na ou folafolaina atu ia te outou, na outou talia foi, o loo tumau i ai foi outou,

verses.en: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
verses.sm: ua ola ai foi outou; pe afai tou te taofi mau i le mataupu na folafolaina e a‘u ia te outou; pe afai ua outou le talia fua.

verses.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.sm: Auā na ou tuuina atu ia te outou mea muamua o mea foi ia na ou maua foi e a‘u; na maliu Keriso ma sui o a tatou agasala, pei ona tusia;

verses.en: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
verses.sm: na tanu foi o ia, ma toe tu mai i le aso tolu, pei o upu ua i Tusi.

verses.en: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
verses.sm: Na iloa foi o ia e Kefa, ona iloa lea e le toasefulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
verses.sm: Ona toe iloa lea o ia e le au uso e lima selau ma ona tupu ina ua faatasi; o le toatele foi o i latou o ola mai, ua oo i ona po nei; a o isi ua momoe.

verses.en: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
verses.sm: Ona toe iloa lea o ia e Iakopo, ona iloa lea e le au aposetolo uma.

verses.en: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
verses.sm: E mulimuli lava ona iloa o ia e a‘u nei, e peiseai se tama fanau le au.

verses.en: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.sm: Auā o a‘u o le aupito itiiti o le au aposetolo; e le aoga ona ta‘ua o a‘u o le aposetolo, auā na ou saua atu i le ekalesia a le Atua.

verses.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.sm: A o le alofa tunoa o le Atua ua ou faapenei ai a‘u; o lona alofa tunoa foi o ia te au, e le faaleaogaina lea, a ua sili la‘u galuega i a latou uma; a e peitai e le o a‘u, a o le alofa tunoa o le Atua ua ia te au.

verses.en: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
verses.sm: O lenei, po o a‘u, po o i latou, e faapea ona matou tala‘iina atu, sa faāpea foi ona outou talitonu.

verses.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.sm: Afai foi ua tala‘iina Keriso ua ia toe tu mai nai e ua oti, pe faapefea ona fai mai o isi o outou, e leai se toe tu mai o e ua oti?

verses.en: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
verses.sm: A e afai e leai se toe tu mai o e ua oti, po ua le toe faatuina mai Keriso;

verses.en: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
verses.sm: afai foi ua le toe faatuina mai Keriso, po ua faaleaoga la matou tala‘i, ua faaleaoga foi lo outou faatuatua.

verses.en: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
verses.sm: Ua avea foi i matou ma molimau pepelo i a le Atua; auā ua molimau i matou i le Atua, na ia toe faatuina mai Keriso, o le na le toe faatuinā e ia, pe afai e moi e le toe tutū mai e ua oti.

verses.en: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
verses.sm: Auā afai e le toe tutū mai e ua oti, po ua le toe faatuina ma Keriso.

verses.en: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
verses.sm: ' Afai foi ua le toe faatuina Keriso, ua faaleaoga lo outou faatuatua, ua nofo sala pea outou;

verses.en: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
verses.sm: i le ma lea foi, ua fano e ua momoe ia Keriso.

verses.en: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
verses.sm: Afai e gata i lenei olaga mea tatou te faamoemoe i ai ia Keriso, ua sili lo tatou malaia i tagata uma lava.

verses.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.sm: A o lenei, ua toe faatuina mai Keriso i e ua oti, ua avea ma faapolopolo o e ua momoe.

verses.en: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.sm: Auā ua oo mai le oti talu le tagata, ua oo mai foi le toe tutū o e ua oti talu le tagata.

verses.en: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.sm: Auā faapei ona oti uma ia Atamu, e faapea foi ona faaolaina uma ia Keriso.

verses.en: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
verses.sm: A e peitai e taitoatasi ma lona lava tofi; o le faapolopolo o Keriso lea, mulimuli ane o e o-ia Keriso e toe tutū i lona afio mai.

verses.en: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.sm: Ona oo ai lea i le gataaga, e tuuina atu ai e ia le malo i le Atua, o le Tamā lea, pe a uma ona faaumatia e ia o alii sili uma, ma faipule uma, ma e malolosi.

verses.en: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
verses.sm: Auā e tatau ona pule o ia, seia tuuina e ia ona fili uma lava i lalo o ona vae.

verses.en: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
verses.sm: O le toe fili e faaumatia, o le oti lea;

verses.en: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.sm: auā, Ua tuuina e ia o mea uma i lalo o ona vae f a e peitai ina ua fai mai, Ua tuuina i lalo mea uma ia te ia, ua iloa tino ai, ua vavae atu le na ia tuuina i lalo o mea uma ia te ia.

verses.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.sm: Pe a uma foi ona tuuina i lalo ia te ia o mea uma, ona tuuina i lalo foi lea o le Alo lava i le na tuuina i lalo ia te ia o mea uma, ina ia pule aoao le Atua i le aoao o mea.

verses.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
verses.sm: A faapea, pe faapefea e ua papatisoina ma sui o e ua oti? Afai e moni, e le toe tutū e ua oti, ona o le a ea ua papatisoina ai i latou ma sui o e ua oti?

verses.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
verses.sm: Se a f oi e pagatia ai i matou i itu aso uma lava?

verses.en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.sm: Ou te au'gani ile mitamita ua ia te au ona o. outou ia Keriso Iesu lo tatou Alii, ou te oti i aso fai soo.

verses.en: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
verses.sm: Se a ea se aoga ia te au ona ua ou tau ma manu feai i Efeso, pei o le tu a tagata, pe afai e le toe tutū e ua oti? ina tatou aai ma inu, auā o a taeao tatou te oti ai.

verses.en: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
verses.sm: Aua ne‘i faaseseina outou, O le feoai ma e amio leaga e leaga ai amio lelei.

verses.en: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
verses.sm: Ina ala mai ia i le amiotonu, a e aua nefi agasala; auā ua pouliuli nisi i la le Atua; ou te faapea atu ia te outou e faamā ia te outou.

verses.en: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
verses.sm: A e fai mai se tasi, Pe faapefea ona toe tutū mai ō e ua oti? se a' foi le uiga o le tino latou te o mai ai?

verses.en: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
verses.sm: O oe na le valea; o le mea e luluina e oe e le ola lea pe afai e le pala.

verses.en: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
verses.sm: O le mea foi e te lulu, ua e le luluina le tino e tupu ai; a o le fua lava, atonu se saito, po o se tasi o ia mea.

verses.en: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
verses.sm: A e avane i ai le tino e le Atua, pei ona finagalo i ai o ia; o fua foi taitasi ma lona lava tino.

verses.en: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
verses.sm: Ua le tino e tasi tino uma lava; a 39^ e ese le tino o tagata, ese le tino o manu, ese le tino o la, ese le tino o manu felelei.

verses.en: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
verses.sm: E i ai foi tino faalelagi ma tino faalelalolagi; a e ese le matagofie o le faalelagi, ese lo le faalelalolagi.

verses.en: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
verses.sm: E ese le pupula o le la, ese foi le pupula o le masina, ese foi le pupula o fetu; auā ua ese le pupula o le tasi fetu i lo le tasi fetu.

verses.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.sm: E faapea foi le toe tutū mai o e ua oti; eTuluina ma le pala, e toe faatuina mai ma le le pala;

verses.en: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.sm: e luluina ma le matagā, e toe faatuina mai ma le matagofie; e luluina ma le vaivai, e toe faatuina mai ina le malosi;

verses.en: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.sm: e luluina le tino faaletino, e toe faatuina mai o le tino faaleagaga; e i ai le tino faaletino,

verses.en: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
verses.sm: e i ai foi le tino faaleagaga. E faapea foi ona tusia, Ka faia Atamu le uluai tagata ma tagata ola; a o le Atamu mulimuli, o le Agaga faaola o ia.

verses.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
verses.sm: A e peitai e le muamua le faaleagaga, a o le faaletino; ona mulimuli ai lea o le faaleagaga.

verses.en: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.sm: E faaleeleele le uluai tagata, na fua mai i le eleele;, a o le tagata mulimuli, o le Alii lea mai le lagi.

verses.en: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.sm: Pei o le faaleeleele, e faapea lava o e faaleeleele; pei o le faalelagi, e faapea lava o e faalelagi.

verses.en: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.sm: Faapei ona foliga o i tatou i le faaleeleele, e faapea lava ona foliga o i tatou i le faalelagi.

verses.en: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.sm: Le au uso e, o la‘u upu lenei, e le mafaia ona avea o le malo o le Atua ma tofi o i latou ua i ai tino aano ma toto; e le fai foi le ola pea ma tofi o le iu vale.

verses.en: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.sm: Faauta mai, ou te ta‘u atu ia te outou le mea lilo; e le momoe \ tatou uma, a e liua i tatou uma,

verses.en: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.sm: e faafuasei lava, o le emo o le mata, pe a ilia le pu faauma; auā e ilia lava, e toe tutū mai ai e ua oti ma le ola pea, e liua foi i tatou.

verses.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.sm: Auā e tatau ona ofu o lenei tino iu vale i le tino ola pea, ia ofu foi lenei tino oti i le tino le oti lava.

verses.en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.sm: Pe a ofu foi lenei tino iu vale i le tino ola pea, a ofu foi lenei tino oti i le tino le oti lava, ona taunuu ai lea o le upu ua tusia, Ua faaumatia le oti i le manumalo.

verses.en: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
verses.sm: Le oti e, o fea o i ai lou tui? Le tuugamau e, o fea o i ai lou manumalo?

verses.en: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
verses.sm: O le tui o le oti, o le agasala lea, o le malosi foi o le agasala o le tulafono lea;

w.en: which is the of the law

verses.en: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.sm: a e faafetai i le Atua, o le na te foaiina mai le manumalo ia te i tatou talu lo tatou Alii o Iesu Keriso.

verses.en: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.sm: O lenei, o‘u uso pele e, ia outou tumau, ma le le faagaeetia, ia alualu lo outou faamalosi i le galuega a le Alii ma le, le aunoa ina ua outou iloa e le se mea faaleaoga lo outou tautiga i le Alii. O sauniga eseese, ma le moliga o le
